definition: to keep yourself or something from being seen
description: A dark room where someone is pressed behind a heavy beige curtain with only a hand showing at the gap. Cut to an office, where a grinning man in a blue polo shirt is folded up under a desk with his arms round his knees. Then a small boy in a red shirt presses himself against a wide tree trunk in a park and peers round it with wide eyes. A quiet living room with an empty fireplace swings past, and finally a whole group of people leap up from behind a sofa with their arms in the air as confetti falls.

taps.target: the man in the blue shirt
